subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session state be handled as diagnostic-only reporting, an explicit backed-up repair/reset, or automatic startup quarantine?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but moving or recreating persisted session state affects data preservation, operator surprise, and channel availability policy.

options.title: Add explicit backed-up repair
options.body: Status/doctor should flag corrupt state and offer a command or doctor repair that backs up the artifact before resetting it.

options.title: Report only
options.body: Status/doctor would identify the bad file and recommended manual steps without changing session state automatically.

options.title: Auto-quarantine on startup
options.body: Gateway startup would move bad artifacts aside and recreate state automatically, accepting a stronger availability-first policy.

recommendation.title: Add explicit backed-up repair
recommendation.body: Status/doctor should flag corrupt state and offer a command or doctor repair that backs up the artifact before resetting it.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history in the shallow checkout ties this area to recent session-store and Telegram status refactor work.
